verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair axis for a chat platform with an API and bot framework, but the evidence documents no Zulip sandbox, test organization, or isolated dev realm. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: self-hosting a separate server or exporting and importing data is a user-side workaround, and the Botserver note only describes moving a bot to production.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
